name: Deathly Escape
source:
A woman wakes up in a bedroom with no memory of who or where she is. She finds clues around the room to see if there is anything familiar. Spotting a mirror, she looks at the bruises and cuts on her face as she cries in fear of being in an unsafe place. She wanted to get out, until a mysterious man comes inside the bedroom.

The man tells her what she wanted to know -- who she is, who he is, why she's here, and her relationship with him. Her name is "Anne", his name is "Ryan", he's protecting her from anyone suspicious chasing after her, and he claims he is her husband. She wanted to believe it... until one day she got a call from her "best friend" who told her information completely different from her husband's.

There is danger, and Anne can sense it. What clues will she find in the bedroom to convince herself that she needs to flee or stay?

[From [url=https://eeveetron.itch.io/deathly-escape]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名女子在卧室中醒来，不记得自己是谁或在哪里。她在房间里寻找线索，看看是否有熟悉的东西。她看到一面镜子，看着自己脸上的瘀伤和割伤，因为害怕身处不安全的地方而哭泣。她想要出去，直到一个神秘男人走进卧室。

这个男人告诉她她想知道的事情——她是谁，他是谁，她为什么在这里，以及她和他的关系。她的名字叫“安妮”，他的名字叫“瑞安”，他保护她免受任何可疑追捕她的人的侵害，他声称自己是她的丈夫。她想要相信这一点……直到有一天，她接到“最好的朋友”的电话，告诉她的信息与她丈夫的完全不同。

有危险，安妮能感觉到。她会在卧室里找到什么线索来说服自己需要逃跑还是留下来？

[来自[url=https://eeveetron.itch.io/deathly-escape]Itch.io[/url]]
